messages:
maria: Quick follow-up after yesterday's outage — need to lock the public postmortem blurb and who sends the customer note. Draft proposal below.
incident-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-0923
maria: Draft blurb: "We experienced a service disruption affecting generation for ~45 minutes due to an autoscaling configuration issue; service was restored at 14:25 UTC. A detailed incident summary will be shared within 72 hours." Thoughts on tone/accuracy?
sophie: I like concise timeline. Recommend we swap 'investigation underway' for a firm ETA so customers know when to expect the summary.
jamal: Support request: include link to status guidance and contact alias in the customer note. Also confirm whether data exposure occurred (we should say explicitly if none).
kevin: Confirming no customer data exposure. Root cause is an autoscaler race + bad rollout config. For the public note keep details high-level; technical appendix goes in internal RCA.
sophie: Proposed public wording: "We experienced a service disruption impacting text generation from 13:40–14:25 UTC due to an autoscaling configuration issue. Service is fully restored. A detailed incident summary will be posted by 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC." OK?
maria: That ETA works. Who owns the 72h summary and who distributes to customers vs. statuspage?
kevin: I'll own the technical RCA draft (kevin, SRE) — will have a draft by Tue 18:00 UTC.
jamal: I'll own the customer-facing note and impacted customer list (jamal, Support). Will coordinate redactions per legal.
sophie: I'll approve the public copy and publish the status page update (sophie, Comms).
maria: Action items (summarized):
- kevin: internal RCA draft (due Tue 18:00 UTC)
- jamal: customer-facing note + impacted list (due Wed 12:00 UTC)
- sophie: finalize and publish status page text (due Wed 13:00 UTC)
- maria: review and final sign-off (due Wed 15:00 UTC)
Please call out any blockers or missing owners.
kevin: Blocker: I need autoscaler logs from the rollout window — requested from eng-infra, ETA ~6h.
jamal: Quick policy question — are we sharing the full RCA externally by default? Support expects a summary; some customers will request full docs under NDA.
sophie: Policy recap: default = summarized public postmortem. Full internal RCAs are shared case-by-case after redaction + legal review. We should note required approvals in the customer note.
maria: Agreed. Add redaction checklist for any externally-shared RCA: strip internal hostnames, IPs, runbook steps, and customer identifiers.
jamal: noted and will apply redactions.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled — 24h action-item check-in for this thread.
maria: I'll run the 24h sweep and post status updates here. Thanks all :pray:
kevin: Will ping when logs arrive.
sophie: Preparing statuspage patch now; will hold publish until final wording is confirmed.
jamal: Drafting customer email + sample language, will post for sign-off in this thread.
maria: For recurring incident patterns: let's add this to the incident trends board to track autoscale-related regressions monthly. Assigning trend ownership to kevin.
kevin: Happy to own trend tracking and follow-up items.
maria: I'll update the action tracker (https://redwood.internal/actions/INC-2026-0923) and create Jira tickets for each owner.
sophie: :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks, will sync on logs.
maria: Closing — please update the tracker as you complete items and ping if any timeline slips.
sophie: Will post final statuspage copy once approved.
jamal: Will post customer list and sample email by EOD tomorrow.
maria: Thanks everyone, will reconvene after the 24h sweep.
